cases.task: On arxiv.org, use Advanced Search to search all fields for reinforcement learning. Select both Computer Science and Mathematics, with no other subject areas, and filter by the most recent submission date from September 1, 2024 through January 31, 2025. Submit the search and leave the results page open.

The results page is open, showing 1–50 of 2,345 results matching the query.
